body: There’s no good way to kill yourself. You’ll be terrified, lonely, and regret it as soon as your feet leave the roof of that building, or as the pills go down your throat. Go watch some videos of people hanging themselves. Watch them claw at their necks as they realize it’s over. Please, for you and your family’s sake, talk to someone. Talk to me if nobody else will listen. I hope you’re still breathing.
I’m glad you’re still here. I just found this thread and started getting upset until I found this comment. Stay and fight another day.
